name: Contact Physics
author: Kizi
description: Rigid-body car contact for every car: mass, inertia, bounce, friction and rolling tyres that rub. AI reaction time that grows with the hit, softening off, punctures.

options.label: Contact: strength
options.description: How strong car contact is. Normal = tuned values (tyre friction 1.8, bodies 0.6, bounce 0.25). x1.5 / x2 / x3 scale bounce and friction (bounce max 0.8, friction max 3.0).

options.label: Contact: bounce
options.description: How much cars bounce apart after a hit: 0.1 / 0.25 / 0.4 of the closing speed.

options.label: Contact: friction
options.description: Grip between the touching parts: tyre on tyre 1.8, bodies 0.6 at Medium (Low x0.5, High x1.5).

options.label: Contact: tyre rotation
options.description: Rolling tyre surfaces rub in tyre-on-tyre touches (rubber on rubber), like real wheel-over-wheel contact: a chasing car can climb the tyre ahead and launch.

options.label: Contact: push AI cars
options.description: On = AI cars take the push too and AI-AI touches count. Off = only your car is pushed (the game's own rule).

options.label: Contact: game's own response
options.description: Add = ours first, the game still fixes overlap (recommended). Ignore = ours only; hard hits can leave cars inside each other.

options.label: Contact: AI reaction time
options.description: After a hit, the AI car's steering is held where it was before the AI reacts, so the hit can turn the car. Fixed 0.2 / 0.4 / 0.6 s, or scaled: 0.1 s for a light nudge up to 1.0 s for a big hit.

options.label: Contact: applies to
options.description: Which touches get the contact physics, the reaction time and punctures: all of them (AI against AI too), or only touches with you.

options.label: Contact: tyre punctures
options.description: A hit at a tyre can give it a puncture, the more likely the harder the touch (touches under 10 km/h never do, full chance from 60 km/h). Uses the game's own puncture, so the tyre loses air and may burst.

options.label: Contact: punctures can hit you
options.description: Off = only AI cars get punctures from contact. On = your tyres too.

options.label: Contact: softening
options.description: The game softens every car-to-car hit with two assists. Off = hits are not softened. Ctrl+F9 switches it during a race.

options.label: On-screen messages
options.description: Shows on-screen messages in the game's race notification.

options.label: Testing: log contacts
options.description: Writes every car-to-car touch to swofty\loader.log (who touched, how hard, how far each car turned). Only for testing; leave off.
